# tu 1.1.1 — Raspberry Pi 1 / Zero support

Patch release. No behaviour changes in `tu` itself.

## What's new since `v1.1.0`

- **ARMv6 build.** New `tu-1.1.1-arm-unknown-linux-gnueabihf.tar.gz`
  for Raspberry Pi 1, Zero and Zero W (BCM2835, ARM1176). The
  `armv7` build never ran on those boards.
- **`armhf.deb` now works on every 32-bit Pi.** It is built from the
  ARMv6 binary, so one package covers Pi 1 / Zero through Pi 5 on a
  32-bit Raspberry Pi OS. Pi 2 and up still get the `armv7` tarball
  if you prefer it.
- **`install.sh` fix.** `armv6l` used to be mapped to the ARMv7
  asset, which cannot run on a Pi Zero. It now picks the ARMv6 build.
- README gains a Raspberry Pi cheat sheet (model → SoC → which asset
  for 64-bit vs 32-bit OS).

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

See the release assets below for `.deb` / `.rpm` / tarballs, and
`SHA256SUMS` to verify them:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
```
